target_segments: The participant must meet all of the following pulmonary parameters: forced expiratory volume in one second at least 50 percent predicted, and resting oxygen saturation at least 92 percent on room air.

text_span: forced expiratory volume in one second at least 50 percent predicted
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: this is an independently evaluable pulmonary-function threshold.

text_span: resting oxygen saturation at least 92 percent on room air
sub_criteria.rationale: H1-B: this is a distinct independently evaluable oxygenation threshold.

output.notes: The stated pulmonary-parameter wrapper is fully operationalized by the two listed required thresholds.
